note: Triennial election of Dungannon Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Thirteen Unionists and six Nationalists were returned unopposed. The report names only the two Unionist changes, in Anahoe and Altmore (Belfast News-Letter, 17 May 1961, p. 7). Council-meeting method: division inferred from the 5 June 1958 return (Bush: Cecil J. Burrowes); the Belfast Telegraph, 28 July 1961, p. 2 names him as chairman of the council eight weeks after the election. He sat for Bush again in 1964. Returned unopposed.
